# X360 Mobile 0.6.5 Hotfix 4

Maintenance update focused on clearer Vulkan driver error reporting.

- Improved visibility and consistency of diagnostic messages when a driver cannot start or stops responding.
- Clearer on-device troubleshooting feedback for experimental driver configurations.

Custom driver compatibility remains device-dependent. This hotfix does not guarantee successful driver loading or resolve game rendering issues.

Install over your current version; no uninstall is required.
